items.title: 67296_Chauncey Morehouse oral history interview
items.q: The name 'Betsy' appears only in the title of a song mentioned by the interviewer ('Betsy Didn't Help It'). The interviewee does not mention Betsy personally.

ctx.x: And we played at the Alamac Hotel.
On Bix's last recording session with Hoagy Carmichael, some of them say you're in it. Some say you aren't. "A Night in Havana", "Betsy Didn't Help It."

Bix didn't use me as much as he could have. And he would have a record date and I would have a record date. And there was no way of keeping track of Bix. And I wasn't a good enough businessman to see that I kept track with him. Because I was a big shot. And I was up here a big shot. And I thought what the hell, if they want me, they'll call me.
